UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile in the Aurum Finance application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user profile, matching Firebase Auth UID.

secretKey.description: A secret key used for authentication.

kycStatus.description: The KYC verification status of the user (e.g., pending, approved, rejected).

loanAmount.description: The current loan amount requested by the user.

loanStatus.description: The status of the current loan.

loanReason.description: The reason or AI rationale for the current loan status.

definition.description: Stores user profile information. The 'userId' is the Firebase Auth UID. This path provides path-based ownership for user-specific data.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user.
